title: Picture Web

serves.summary: The child drags pictures into a word web around a topic (farm, pets, the sea) to group the things that belong and leave out the ones that do not, including look-alikes and things only seen nearby, and picks the topic for the centre when it is not named, which shows sorting words into categories and building thematic word webs.

request.topic: Word webs: things that belong to one topic
request.objective: Build a web of 3-4 pictures that belong to one topic and leave out the pictures that do not; when the topic is not named, put the topic that fits in the centre. (LA005-03-F)

problems.ask: Make a farm web. Put in the things that belong on a farm.
problems.goal: Cow, pig and hen around the farm; the rocket stays out.

problems.ask: Make a pets web. Put in the animals that can be pets at home.
problems.goal: Dog, cat and goldfish; the wolf (looks like the dog) stays out.

problems.ask: Make a web of animals that live in the sea.
problems.goal: Octopus, whale, crab and fish; the beach umbrella (seen at the sea) and the cow stay out.

problems.ask: Make a web of things that go together, with the place they all belong in the middle.
problems.goal: School in the centre with pencil, school bag and books; the beach and the shell stay out.
